title: SDK-Managed Worker Runtime
summary: Wave 2 backend substrate and builder-facing UI are complete through PRs #79 and #78. Terminal takeover/cleanup remains ready, startup reconciliation is promoted as a Wave 2 safety node, managed-session console captures the read-only Copilot-CLI-like monitoring surface, and a Wave 2 punch-list node collects closeout tweaks before the usability gate.

nodes.title: SDK capability parity research
nodes.summary: Completed via PR #63: reported constrained-go SDK/CLI parity findings, reusable smoke/spike harnesses, progress redaction guidance, cancellation and permission-policy evidence, terminal takeover verification, Streamliner plugin claim-binding evidence, and local PR-production dogfood.

nodes.title: Managed worker runtime contract
nodes.summary: Completed via PR #67 plus #62 gate amendment: accepted the product/runtime contract for managed node execution, including lifecycle states, registry identity, redacted progress, managed-autonomous permission posture, node launch selection, one-way terminal takeover, cleanup, and review-loop exports.

nodes.title: Foundation contract gate
nodes.summary: Passed with constraints: SDK capability evidence and runtime contract support a constrained-go path, and Wave 2 must implement builder-selected managed-autonomous execution with no per-tool approval flow during SDK-owned runs.

nodes.title: Managed execution substrate
nodes.summary: Completed via PR #79: added the backend/API substrate for explicit managed-sdk graph-node execution, canonical registry runtime metadata, managed-autonomous SDK permission handling, lifecycle/progress/evidence projection, interruption/cancel routes, conservative PR evidence detection, and graph/session projections without mutating graph.json.

nodes.title: Builder-facing managed runtime UI
nodes.summary: Completed via PR #78: added the builder-facing Background Session UI for managed-sdk launch selection, managed-autonomous consent/profile display, My Sessions and graph/node-inspector runtime rendering, sanitized progress display, and disabled placeholders for takeover and cleanup follow-on actions.

nodes.title: Terminal takeover and cleanup actions
nodes.summary: Ship the operational lifecycle actions that make managed SDK sessions usable: interrupt and open one-way Copilot CLI takeover, plus cleanup-after-merge for linked worktrees/local branches without requiring terminal interaction for simple autonomous runs.

nodes.title: Managed runtime startup reconciliation
nodes.summary: Reconcile stale active managed SDK runtime rows on API startup so Streamliner does not show phantom running background sessions after API/process restart. Active rows that cannot be verified as live should move to a safe diagnostic state with a typed reason and builder action.

nodes.title: Managed session console
nodes.summary: Implement the missing read-only, terminal-looking console for Streamliner-managed work: live/replayed sanitized activity for PAW launch preparation and SDK-managed background sessions, typed waiting-for-builder reasons, PR-ready trust markers, and entry points from launch, graph/node, and My Sessions surfaces without becoming an interactive terminal or raw event stream.

nodes.title: Managed runtime Wave 2 punch list
nodes.summary: Collect and resolve small Wave 2 usability and closeout fixes before the managed-runtime usability gate. Initial item: make Sessions show active session-specific filter criteria when Open in Sessions routes to a managed/ended session hidden until Show ended is enabled.

nodes.title: Managed runtime usability gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates that the SDK-managed launch, terminal-like read-only monitoring, takeover, and cleanup experience is usable and safe enough to proceed into dogfood hardening and downstream export work.

nodes.title: Managed runtime dogfood and hardening
nodes.summary: Dogfood SDK-managed execution on real node work, verify sdkSessionId resumability after pr_ready, exercise crash/restart reconciliation, prototype operational signals, evaluate whether managed-review profile semantics are needed, reconcile docs and graph assumptions, and prepare the managed-worker runtime export for Automated PAW Review Loop.

nodes.title: Managed worker runtime export gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates that SDK-managed node execution is usable, documented, and stable enough for Automated PAW Review Loop to consume.

checkpoints.title: Foundation contract aligned
checkpoints.summary: SDK capability parity is understood and the builder has accepted the managed-worker runtime contract with explicit managed-autonomous permission constraints.

checkpoints.title: Managed runtime usable
checkpoints.summary: The builder has validated the usable SDK-managed runtime: node launch selection, managed execution, read-only terminal-like monitoring, terminal takeover, and cleanup after merge.

checkpoints.title: Review loop export ready
checkpoints.summary: The managed-worker runtime has been dogfooded, hardened, and accepted as an export for Automated PAW Review Loop.
